name: typewriter
blurb: Types out a base string, then cycles through alternating phrases with a blinking cursor.
description: Animates character-by-character typing of a baseText, then cycles through a texts array repeatedly, typing and reversing each. Includes a blinking cursor sprite.
use_when: Hero sections or call-to-action copy that should feel interactive and personable.
avoid_when: Large amounts of text; animation harms readability and performance degrades with character count.
a11y: Text is rendered in the DOM; blinking cursor animation does not respect prefers-reduced-motion.
